meta.title: Counter offer during evaluation time on both lines; the vendor does not answer
gaps: The prepared event has only one line, so the requested two-line counter offer cannot be tested.
Changing both quoted prices from 100 to 90 and 50 to 45 cannot be expressed because place_counter_offer accepts only one counter price and does not expose line selection.
The vendor not answering while the offer remains explicitly pending cannot be asserted as a state.
Vendor A being unable to revise any line while the counter offer is pending cannot be asserted.
Master QCS totals for both lines cannot be checked because the prepared state has only one line.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen, which is the required starting point for this existing event.
Send the expressible single-line counter offer during the prepared evaluation state.
Assert that the buyer's grid records the counter offer as initiated.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event's vendor overview to inspect the unanswered counter offer.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the pending counter-offer context without accepting it.
Return to the buyer's event page without taking any vendor response action.
Open Master QCS after the vendor has not answered.
Assert the available one-line Master QCS arithmetic remains internally consistent with the current displayed price.
